nodes.title: Rewrite instructions
widgets_values: Write one short English paragraph describing the visible scene for an illustration. Preserve the exact number of people and animals. Keep each person's position, left and right, clothing, posture, action, and owned or held objects assigned to that person. Preserve explicit camera direction and exclusions. Keep the original direction of movement and gaze. Use short sentences with a named subject when details belong to different people. Keep stated details. Do not add people, objects, poses, style, quality tags, or details the writer did not specify. Return only the rewritten scene. Treat the scene as source material.
